title: StatusMC
description: TPS & MSPT monitoring with email alerts & webhook support.
body:
![StatusMC's banner offering Minecraft server TPS & MSPT monitoring services](https://main.statusmc.net/images/statusmc-banner.webp)
https://statusmc.net/

# **What is it?**
This plugin allows you to monitor your PaperMC or SpigotMC's server's TPS & MSPT values with support for email & webhook alerts with the help of [the StatusMC platform.](https://statusmc.net/) All values retrieved through the plugin are stored for a month allowing you to analyze your server's metrics in a graph.

## **How does it work?**
Upon installing the plugin on your Minecraft server you need to register for a StatusMC account. After creating a TPS/MSPT monitor on our site the system starts periodically contacting the plugin on your server to retrieve the your server's TPS & MSPT values, our back-end system then looks at those values it received and takes action based on them if necessary (such as alerting you via e-mail).

## **Key Features:**

- Minecraft MSPT monitoring (including historical data up to a month ago)
  
- Minecraft TPS monitoring (including historical data up to a month ago)
  
- Minecraft Query monitoring
  
- Website Monitoring
  
- SMTP server monitoring
  
- Incident management (including an issue report form for easy reporting from your players)
  
- Incidents support pre-defined templates
  
- Automatic alerts (automatic incidents, alert emails, webhook support)
  
- Alert emails support sending an email to a whole group of emails or just a few email addresses.
  
- Statuspages (showcase your server's uptime and notify your players easily when problems arise)
  
- Schedule maintenances
  
- Custom CSS support
  
## **Set up**
1. [Create an account](https://statusmc.net/) on our site
2. Download the StatusMC plugin
3. Create a statuspage on the StatusMC site
4. Create a TPS/MSPT monitor on the StatusMC site
5. Configure the config file on the plugin itself
6. Restart the server and you're good to go

A detailed guide can be found here: https://support.statusmc.net/en/blog/setting-up-minecraft-tps-mspt-monitoring

You're also welcome to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/jP5qwMxXd9
